description: KFLT v1 frozen vector: a fully SIGNED KFLT blob that must verify against pinnedPubkeyHex AND context via verifyFilterBlob / verifyAndParseFilter, for @forgesworn/tessera-kit. The signed digest is now bound to a deployment `context` string (PROTOCOL.md §4.1/§4.3): the same blob checked against `mustRejectContext` (a different, well-formed context) MUST fail. Contradicts the (incorrect) prior claim that "signatures cannot be frozen": BIP340 aux randomness only affects producing a NEW signature, not re-verifying an already-frozen one — verify() is fully deterministic. digestHexIndependent is hand-checked via node:crypto, re-implementing computeDigest (sign.ts) with no @noble/hashes involvement, and must match the digest actually signed. Signed by a labelled deterministic demo key (NOT a real secret). memberKeysHex are generated by the documented rule member_i = hex(sha256("tessera-vec:" + i)) for i in [0, memberCount) (see CONFORMANCE.md) — NOT re-derived by the checker (the frozen blobHex is authoritative), but included so a port can cross-check its own member-generation rule against this vector too.
